caption: A buyer writes at 21:40, after the office has closed, and gets the price at once from the agency’s own listings
Four short questions, one per message: flat size, budget, when they plan to buy, and area
It reads the calendar and offers free site-visit times
The visit is booked and logged, and a strong lead is passed to a sales person
Asked for a better price or about a loan, it does not haggle or advise: a person will call
What the sales team sees in the morning: each lead marked hot, warm or cold by a fixed rule, with the reason
A reminder the day before the visit, and one friendly nudge for a buyer who went quiet
